title: Our House Leans Toward HIS 🏠
description:
On our street, when neighbors fight, their houses lean toward each other until they make up. Two bakeries downtown are kissing over the road.

My dad and Mr. Pruitt next door have fought for forty years. Our house leans eleven feet toward his. Then a storm pushed our windows a foot apart, and at two in the morning, something reached out of his.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
